Undergraduate (UG): Minimum Qualification: 50% in Physics, Mathematics, and one subject from Chemistry/Biology/Biotechnology/Computer Science/IT. 60% for Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering. Age: 16 years and 6 months by 31st July of the admission year. Attempts: Maximum of 2 attempts including improvements.. Postgraduate (PG): General Requirement: B.E./B.Tech in a relevant field, or M.Sc./MCA for specific programs. Program Preferences: GATE score or work experience preferred for certain specializations. Specializations: Core fields: Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, and Computer Science. Emerging fields: Big Data, Cloud Computing, Biotechnology, Biomedical, and CAD. --> Courses We Offer COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY UNDERGRADUATE COURSES (DURATION 4 YEARS) QUALIFYING EXAMINATION Applicant should have passed in Higher secondary examination (10, +2 pattern) or appearing in Higher Secondary examination in the current academic year with a minimum of 60% aggregate ( 3 subjects) in Physics (mandatory) , Mathematics (mandatory) and at least one of Chemistry / Biotechnology / Biology / Computer Science / Information Technology / Informatics Practices / Engineering Graphics / Botany and (or) Zoology as major subjects in regular subjects in regular stream from any board within India , CBSE , ISCE , Matriculation , IB or NIOS NOTE: For B.Tech Programs offered by the Department of Biotechnology, Department of Genetic Engineering and Department of Biomedical Engineering – Minimum 60% aggregate in PCM / PMB/PCB/PCB or Z (Botany or Zoology). Students who have not studied Mathematics as one of the major subjects in +2 must undertake an additional 4 credit courses in Mathematics during the First Year of B.Tech. Students who have completed +2 under NIOS must have completed the 10th standard from regular schooling or vice-versa. Students who have not studied Chemistry should undergo a bridge course in Chemistry in the first year.
